about: GovInfo (U.S. Government Publishing Office): browse collections such as Congressional Bills and the Federal Register, read daily Federal Register tables of contents, look up document details, related documents, committee publications and government authors, and fetch document text and MODS metadata.

commands.summary: List GovInfo collection categories and the collections (code, slug) in each
Get metadata for a collection: title, description, help/RSS links and related resources

params.name: collection
params.description: Lowercase collection code, e.g. bills, fr, plaw, crpt, chrg, budget, cpd

commands.summary: List the top-level browse nodes of a collection (congresses for bills, years for the Federal Register) with document counts

params.name: collection
params.description: Lowercase collection code, e.g. bills, fr

commands.summary: List the bill types (hr, s, hres, hjres, hconres, ...) in a Congress, with counts
List the bill-number ranges (e.g. [0-99]) for one bill type in a Congress, with counts
List bill versions (package IDs, titles, publish dates, file links) in a bill-number range of a Congress and bill type

params.name: range
params.description: Bill-number range in brackets, as given by list-bill-ranges browsePathAlias, e.g. [0-99], [100-199]

commands.summary: List the months of a Federal Register year, with document counts
List the daily Federal Register issues in a month (issue labels like 'Friday, January 31, Pages 8625-8752') with whole-issue download links
List the agencies that have documents in one daily Federal Register issue, with counts

params.name: issue
params.description: Issue label exactly as returned by list-fr-issues (nodeValue.value)

commands.summary: List one agency's documents in a daily Federal Register issue (granule IDs, titles, sections, pages)

params.name: issue
params.description: Issue label as returned by list-fr-issues

params.name: agency
params.description: Agency name as returned by list-fr-issue-agencies

commands.summary: Get the Federal Register table of contents for a date: every agency with its document subjects, pages and FR doc numbers
Get details for a document (granule) or package: title, metadata table, download links (PDF/HTML/MODS/ZIP), citations and dates

params.name: packageId
params.description: Package ID, e.g. FR-2025-01-31 or BILLS-119hr30ih

params.name: granuleId
params.description: Granule ID within the package, e.g. FR doc number 2025-02106; omit for package-level details

commands.summary: List the kinds of related documents available for a granule (e.g. FR-DOCKETID: documents sharing a docket ID)

params.name: relatedType
params.description: Related-content group; FR_CNT for Federal Register documents

commands.summary: List documents related to a granule within a related collection, e.g. Federal Register documents sharing its docket ID

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum number of related documents (the web app sends 25) (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Show where a granule sits in its package (issue/agency browse node) plus whole-issue download renditions
List government authors (agencies, courts, congressional bodies) grouped by executive, judicial and legislative branch
List the publication collections (bills, reports, hearings, ...) available for a congressional committee

params.name: committee
params.description: Committee slug without the chamber prefix (from /browse/committee, e.g. senate-judiciary → judiciary)

commands.summary: List the Congresses for which a committee has publications in one collection (e.g. hearings, reports, bills)

params.name: collection
params.description: Uppercase collection code from browse-committee, e.g. CHRG, BILLS, CRPT

commands.summary: Fetch the full text (HTML rendition) of a bill version or a Federal Register document

params.name: packageId
params.description: Package ID, e.g. FR-2025-01-31 or BILLS-119hr1rh

params.name: fileId
params.description: File ID: the granule ID for FR documents (2025-02106), or the package ID again for bills (BILLS-119hr1rh)

commands.summary: Get the MODS bibliographic metadata of a package (converted from XML to JSON): titles, names/sponsors, dates, identifiers, links

params.name: packageId
params.description: Package ID, e.g. BILLS-119hr30ih or FR-2025-01-31
